title: tassadia decalepis
intro: Tassadia decalepis, commonly known as Katki or Katki root, is a plant species native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating digestive issues, fever, and other ailments. The bioactive constituents present in Tassadia decalepis include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-diarrheal, anti-microbial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Tassadia decalepis are believed to be attributed to its ability to modulate gut motility and protect the gut epithelial lining.
